text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, Trainer.
That means today's menu is finished!
choice_data_list: That was kinda tough, you okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No problem. It didn't push me too hard,
yet it brought out my drive—
a nice balance—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Wait, is that...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I seriously ran my heart out today~☆
Don't I deserve a Nobel Prize for hard work?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
There's still a bit of the menu left, but I worked
this hard, so it should be fine, right? ♡

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Pandora, doing something like that again.
What a hopeless girl, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Being blessed with natural talent can be a problem in itself.
After all, she gets results without even putting in full effort."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, this academy is full of monstrously talented
individuals who never slack on their efforts.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"If you go up against those geniuses
with such sweet, naive thinking..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Truly... Hey, Trainer,
do you mind if I go run with Pandora for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: You have such incredible talent—it would be a waste to leave it buried like this.
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself too hard won't do her any good.
Pushing yourself too hard won't do her any good, you know.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: You have such incredible talent—it would be a waste to leave it buried like this.
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself too hard won't do her any good.
Pushing yourself too hard won't do her any good, you know.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks! Since we're roommates and all,
we might as well push each other to greater heights!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Pandora!
Look at you, working so diligently.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you get it, Heart-chan~?
Right, right?! Isn't it super awesome?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I have a favor to ask of you, Pandora. Would you run alongside me now?
I want to feel your running up close.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehh, but today's training is already over though...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Even geniuses
have things they can't do.
Sorry, I was asking for the impossible.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Nah, it's a total piece of cake!
Guess I have no choice—time to show you all
what Pandora-chan can really do~☆

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's a big help.
Now, before you change your mind,
let's run!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Daring Heart trained hard herself
while keeping Fusaichi Pandora motivated.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. It's nice to worry about your friends, but
first, you need to focus on yourself."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll run against her next time.
That's fine with you, right, Trainer?
